print(resp)

from math import ceil

page_limit = 20
page_index = 0
all_recs = []
while True:
    resp = apis.spotify.show_recommendations(access_token=access_token, page_index=page_index, page_limit=page_limit)
    songs = resp
    if not songs:
        break
    all_recs.extend(songs)
    print('page', page_index, 'returned', len(songs), 'total_so_far', len(all_recs))
    page_index += 1
    if page_index > 50:
        print('safety_break')
        break

# Criteria enumeration (per task): add ALL recommended songs
recs = all_recs
print('criteria:', "all recommended songs")
print('recommended_song_count', len(recs))
print('first5', [(s['song_id'], s['title']) for s in recs[:5]])
print('last5', [(s['song_id'], s['title']) for s in recs[-5:]])

# Current queue length (before reset)
q_before = apis.spotify.show_song_queue(access_token=access_token)
print('queue_before_len', len(q_before))
print('queue_before_is_playing', [x for x in q_before if x.get('is_current') or x.get('is_playing')][:1])

# Reset queue
clear_resp = apis.spotify.clear_song_queue(access_token=access_token)
print('clear_resp', clear_resp)

q_after_clear = apis.spotify.show_song_queue(access_token=access_token)
print('queue_after_clear_len', len(q_after_clear))

# Add all recommended songs to queue
add_results = []
for s in recs:
    r = apis.spotify.add_to_queue(access_token=access_token, song_id=s['song_id'])
    add_results.append((s['song_id'], r))
print('added_count', len(add_results))
print('first_add_resp', add_results[0][1])
print('last_add_resp', add_results[-1][1])

q_after_add = apis.spotify.show_song_queue(access_token=access_token)
print('queue_after_add_len', len(q_after_add))
# verify all added song_ids are present
added_ids = set([s['song_id'] for s in recs])
queue_ids = [x['song_id'] for x in q_after_add]
missing = [i for i in sorted(added_ids) if i not in set(queue_ids)]
extra = [i for i in queue_ids if i not in added_ids]
print('missing_ids_count', len(missing))
print('extra_ids_count', len(extra))

# Shuffle and play
shuf_resp = apis.spotify.shuffle_song_queue(access_token=access_token)
print('shuffle_resp', shuf_resp)
play_resp = apis.spotify.play_music(access_token=access_token, queue_position=0)
print('play_resp', play_resp)

q_final = apis.spotify.show_song_queue(access_token=access_token)
current = [x for x in q_final if x.get('is_current')]
playing = [x for x in q_final if x.get('is_playing')]
print('current_entries', current[:3])
print('playing_entries', playing[:3])

# Pre-completion gate: list explored-but-uncalled APIs
explored = [
    ('spotify','login'),
    ('spotify','show_recommendations'),
    ('spotify','show_song_queue'),
    ('spotify','clear_song_queue'),
    ('spotify','add_to_queue'),
    ('spotify','shuffle_song_queue'),
    ('spotify','play_music'),
    ('spotify','remove_song_from_queue'),
    ('supervisor','complete_task')
]
# APIs actually called in previous execution (manually tracked from code)
called = set([
    ('spotify','login'),
    ('spotify','show_recommendations'),
    ('spotify','show_song_queue'),
    ('spotify','clear_song_queue'),
    ('spotify','add_to_queue'),
    ('spotify','shuffle_song_queue'),
    ('spotify','play_music'),
])

uncalled = [x for x in explored if x not in called]
print('Explored endpoints:', explored)
print('Called endpoints:', sorted(list(called)))
print('Uncalled explored endpoints:', uncalled)
# Justification for each uncalled endpoint
justifications = {}
for app, api_name in uncalled:
    if (app, api_name) == ('spotify','remove_song_from_queue'):
        justifications[(app, api_name)] = "Not needed because we reset queue via clear_song_queue, not per-item removal."
    elif (app, api_name) == ('supervisor','complete_task'):
        justifications[(app, api_name)] = "Will be called now to mark task complete."

for k,v in justifications.items():
    print('Justification', k, '->', v)

# Also print final queue current song for audit

current = [x for x in q_final if x.get('is_current')]
print('Final current song entries:', current)
print('Final queue length:', len(q_final))
